invuselineid.title: Inventory Usage Line Identifier
invuselineid.remarks: Identifies the inventory usage line, which can be associated with a completed transaction.

actualdate.title: Actual Date
actualdate.remarks: The time and date of the receipt or transfer of items. This value can be different from the time and date that the transaction was logged. You can change the value in this field.

rejectqty.title: Quantity Rejected
rejectqty.remarks: The number of items that were rejected. If you enter a value in this field, the number of items in the Quantity field must not include the returned items.

currencylinecost.title: Currency Line Cost
currencylinecost.remarks: The cost per shipment line in the currency of the vendor.

fromconditioncode.title: From Condition Code
fromconditioncode.remarks: The condition code that indicates the physical condition of the item as it was in the originating storeroom.

currencyunitcost.title: Currency Unit Cost
currencyunitcost.remarks: The cost per issue unit in the currency of the vendor.

rotassetnum.title: Rotating Asset
rotassetnum.remarks: Identifies the rotating asset that is associated with the item.

enteredastask.title: Entered as Task
enteredastask.remarks: Indicates whether the current transaction was created based on a work order task.

prorated.title: Prorated
prorated.remarks: Indicates whether the amount for the current line was prorated.

issueto.title: Issue To
issueto.remarks: Identifies the person or craft that the item is being shipped to.

issue.title: Issue on Receipt
issue.remarks: Indicates whether the line item on the current record is a direct issue. Items can be issued to a work order, a general ledger account, a location, or an asset. If the check box is cleared, the item is stocked in a storeroom.

polinenum.title: PO Line
polinenum.remarks: The identifier of the item on the associated purchase order.

enterby.title: Entered By
enterby.remarks: The person who created the shipment receipt record.

courier.title: Courier
courier.remarks: Identifies the company that is employed to transfer the item across organizations.

packingslipnum.title: Packing Slip
packingslipnum.remarks: The number of the packing slip that accompanies the shipment.

fincntrlid.title: FCID
fincntrlid.remarks: The financial control identifier, which is used by the Financial Control application to manage budgets.

tax1code.title: Tax Code 1
tax1code.remarks: The tax code that is used for tax calculation.

mrlinenum.title: Requisition Line
mrlinenum.remarks: The material requisition line number that is associated with the item being issued. The material requisition is created and managed in the Desktop Requisitions application.

tobin.title: To Bin
tobin.remarks: The bin into which the items are to be placed.

costoverreceived.title: Over Received Amount
costoverreceived.remarks: The amount that exceeds the cost of the ordered items.

status.title: Inspection Status
status.remarks: The status that is assigned to the shipment receipt after inspection.

commodity.title: Commodity Code
commodity.remarks: The commodity code that is associated with this item or tool for categorization. Commodity codes are used in the purchasing process. For example, items can be categorized into electrical components or maintenance supplies.

costinfo.title: Cost Information
costinfo.remarks: Information about the cost on the current shipment line.

tax4code.title: Tax Code 4
tax4code.remarks: The tax code that is used for tax calculation.

commoditygroup.title: Commodity Group
commoditygroup.remarks: The commodity group or product category that is associated with this item or tool.

rejectcode.title: Reject Code
rejectcode.remarks: Indicates the reason that the items were rejected by the receiving storeroom, such as when items are damaged.

shipmentlinenum.title: Shipment Line
shipmentlinenum.remarks: The reference number for the shipment line as provided by the supplier.

manufacturer.title: Manufacturer
manufacturer.remarks: Identifies the code that is associated with the manufacturer of the item.

exchangerate2.title: Secondary Exchange Rate
exchangerate2.remarks: The secondary exchange rate that can be applied to the cost of the transfer items.

assetnum.title: Asset
assetnum.remarks: Identifies the asset that is associated with the shipment or line item.

consignment.title: Consignment
consignment.remarks: Indicates whether the transaction was created for a consignment item. This field also indicates that the consignment transaction is included in the consignment invoice, which is sent to the vendor who supplies the inventory item.

curbal.title: Current Balance
curbal.remarks: The storeroom balance at the time of the transfer or receipt of the shipment.

statuschangeby.title: Status Changed By
statuschangeby.remarks: The person who last changed the receipt status.

belongsto.title: Belongs To
belongsto.remarks: Identifies the transaction type of the parent record.

conditioncode.title: To Condition Code
conditioncode.remarks: The condition code that indicates the current physical condition of the item.

shipmentnum.title: Shipment
shipmentnum.remarks: The reference number for the shipment record as provided by the supplier.

tolot.title: To Lot
tolot.remarks: Internal lot number into which the item being transferred or received is placed, which is different than the manufacturer's lot number. The internal lot number is used to track a received item so that it can be used in the appropriate time frame, such as first-in first-out or last-in last-out. Click the Select Value button to choose a lot.

qtyrequested.title: Quantity Requested
qtyrequested.remarks: The quantity of items that were requested to be transferred.

acceptedqty.title: Quantity Accepted
acceptedqty.remarks: The quantity of items that passed inspection.

actualcost.title: Actual Cost
actualcost.remarks: The cost of the item that is being shipped. This value can be different from the unit cost.

glcreditacct.title: GL Credit Account
glcreditacct.remarks: The GL account that is credited when the item is received or transferred.

fromsiteid.title: From Site
fromsiteid.remarks: The identifier of the site that is transferring the inventory items. By default, this value is the site of the selected storeroom.

statusdate.title: Status Date
statusdate.remarks: The date that the receipt status was last changed.

receiptref.title: ReceiptRef
receiptref.remarks: Identifies the transaction type of the related receipt record.

invuselinenum.title: Line
invuselinenum.remarks: Identifies the inventory usage line that is associated with the current record.

tostoreloc.title: To Location
tostoreloc.remarks: The identifier of the storeroom where the items are to be shipped.

ponum.title: PO
ponum.remarks: The purchase order that is associated with the item being shipped.

matrectransid.title: Receipt ID
matrectransid.remarks: The identifier of the shipment receipt record.

issuetype.title: Transaction Type
issuetype.remarks: The type of material receipt transaction that occurs as a result of the shipment.

inspectedqty.title: Quantity to be Inspected
inspectedqty.remarks: The quantity of items that must be inspected before or after transfer.

oldavgcost.title: Old Average Cost
oldavgcost.remarks: The average cost of items, which is calculated at the time of receipt or transfer.

qtyheld.title: Quantity Held
qtyheld.remarks: The quantity of items that are being held for transfer to another site or storeroom.

currencycode.title: Currency
currencycode.remarks: The currency of the purchase requisition.

frombin.title: From Bin
frombin.remarks: The identifier of the storeroom bin from which the current item is being transferred.

receiptquantity.title: Quantity
receiptquantity.remarks: The quantity of items that are being transferred into or out of the storeroom.

totalcurbal.title: Total Current Balance
totalcurbal.remarks: The total balance of items in the storeroom.

porevisionnum.title: PO Revision
porevisionnum.remarks: Indicates the number of times a purchase order has been revised.

siteid.title: Site
siteid.remarks: The site that is associated with the shipment receipt.

qtyoverreceived.title: Over Received Quantity
qtyoverreceived.remarks: The quantity of received items over the amount specified by the PO line. This value is only calculated if a receipt tolerance has been defined.

fromstoreloc.title: From Location
fromstoreloc.remarks: The storeroom where the item is stocked. The storeroom information comes from the user profile, which also contains information about the site and organization.

financialperiod.title: Financial Period
financialperiod.remarks: The financial accounting period in which the current transaction is recorded. This value is based on the actual date of the transaction.

loadedcost.title: Loaded Cost
loadedcost.remarks: The overall cost that is attributed to the line. This value is calculated by multiplying the unit cost by the quantity and adding taxes and special charges.

orgrcvexternalrefid.title: External Reference ID
orgrcvexternalrefid.remarks: The external reference identifier of the original receipt.

modelnum.title: Model
modelnum.remarks: The model code that the manufacturer associates with the item. The default value for this field comes from the inventory record.

receivedunit.title: Order Unit
receivedunit.remarks: The standard unit by which the item is ordered, such as by roll or by case.

tax2code.title: Tax Code 2
tax2code.remarks: The tax code that is used for tax calculation.

orgid.title: Organization
orgid.remarks: The organization that is associated with the shipment receipt.

inspected.title: Inspected
inspected.remarks: Indicates whether the items have been inspected.

consinvoicenum.title: Consignment Invoice
consinvoicenum.remarks: The number that identifies the invoice that was created to pay for the inventory usage.

outside.title: Outside
outside.remarks: Indicates whether the item that is being shipped is a consignment good that belongs to an external vendor, but is stored on-site. If the check box is cleared, there is no charge for using this item.

itemsetid.title: Item Set
itemsetid.remarks: Identifies the item set, or group of items, to which the current item belongs. An organization is assigned to only one item set, but multiple organizations can use the same item set.

linecost2.title: Secondary Line Cost
linecost2.remarks: The secondary cost per shipment line in the currency of the vendor.

exchangerate.title: Exchange Rate
exchangerate.remarks: The exchange rate at the time that the purchase requisition was approved.

linetype.title: Line Type
linetype.remarks: The type of item used on the usage line. For example, Item or Tool.

remark.title: Remarks
remark.remarks: Additional remarks about the current item or shipment.

gldebitacct.title: GL Debit Account
gldebitacct.remarks: The GL account that is debited when the item is received or transferred.

invoicenum.title: Invoice
invoicenum.remarks: The invoice number for the shipment record as provided on the purchase order.

tax1.title: Tax 1
tax1.remarks: The amount of tax that is due for the current line item.

requestedby.title: Requested By
requestedby.remarks: The person who entered a request for the item.

tax2.title: Tax 2
tax2.remarks: The amount of tax that is due for the current line item.

tax3code.title: Tax Code 3
tax3code.remarks: The tax code that is used for tax calculation.

invuseid.title: Usage
invuseid.remarks: Identifies the inventory usage record, which can be associated with a completed transaction.

tax5.title: Tax 5
tax5.remarks: The amount of tax that is due for the current line item.

refwo.title: Work Order
refwo.remarks: Identifies the work order that is associated with the current record.

tax3.title: Tax 3
tax3.remarks: The amount of tax that is due for the current line item.

conversion.title: Conversion Factor
conversion.remarks: The numeric value that is used to convert the order unit of an item to the issue unit of the item. The number of items that you order at one time can be different from the number of items that you issue at one time. For example, if you order in batches of 36 but issue one item at a time, you can define a measurement unit of CASE and another measurement unit of EACH. You define a conversion ratio from CASE to EACH with a factor of 36. Then, when you receive an order of this item into a storeroom, the received order unit of one CASE is converted into issue unit of 36 EACH.

tax4.title: Tax 4
tax4.remarks: The amount of tax that is due for the current line item.

consvendor.title: Consignment Vendor
consvendor.remarks: The vendor that is responsible for replenishing the consignment items. Purchase orders and invoices are generated for the vendor that is specified in this field.

transdate.title: Transaction Date
transdate.remarks: The time and date that the transaction was logged.

positeid.title: PO Site ID
positeid.remarks: Identifies the site where the purchase order was created.

fromlot.title: From Lot
fromlot.remarks: The identifier of the lot where the current item is stored.

mrnum.title: Requisition
mrnum.remarks: The material requisition number that is associated with the current transaction. The material requisition is created and managed in the Desktop Requisitions application.

tax5code.title: Tax Code 5
tax5code.remarks: The tax code that is used for tax calculation.

matusetransid.title: Kit Use Identifier
matusetransid.remarks: The identifier of the MatUseTrans record for the kit item, which is used when breaking an inventory kit.

location.title: Location
location.remarks: The location where the item is to be used.

proratecost.title: Prorate Cost
proratecost.remarks: The amount of added costs that are applied to the cost of the line item.
